0022600165.text: The Pelicans (1-4, 12th in the West) visit the Grizzlies (5-0, 1st in the West), who enter on a five-game winning streak, while New Orleans is 1-4 over its last five games and 0-2 on the road. New Orleans is without Dejounte Murray (personal), Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and Memphis is missing Quinten Post (ankle), Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) and Ty Jerome (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the most recent meeting was a 114-106 Pelicans win in New Orleans on January 30, 2026.
